description:
The Fetcher#fetch method has a complex state machine (fetch_loop) that handles redirects, caching, DNS resolution, and gray placeholder fallbacks. While unit tests exist for individual components (RateLimiter, DnsCache, Semaphore), the main fetch_loop path lacks proper integration test coverage. Need to add tests covering:

1. Full redirect chain with cache miss/hit
2. Gray placeholder detection and fallback
3. DNS revalidation during redirects
4. Timeout handling in the loop
5. Multiple gray_placeholder_attempts with :try_fallback action
6. The visit set loop detection logic

This will help catch regressions in the complex state machine logic (e.g., vugcr-l3q series fixes).
title: Add comprehensive integration tests for Fetcher fetch_loop path
